comment: Pokermon 3.9.1 (InertSteak/Pokermon tag 3.9.1): the static data the 3.9.1 overlay (tools/micatro/gen_pokermon_391_overlay.mjs) is built from. 3.9.1 moved its helpers under pokermon.* namespaces (pokermon.sprites, pokermon.energy, ...): the prelude makes any pokermon.<x> a callable, indexable stub so the files load.
prelude: local mt = {} mt.__index = function(t, k) local v = setmetatable({}, mt) rawset(t, k, v) return v end mt.__call = function() return nil end setmetatable(pokermon, mt)
